title: Privacy Policy | EC Assets
description: How EC Assets handles personal data: what we collect, why, for how long, and the rights you have.

blocks.html: This is a structural placeholder for the mockup. The final wording must come from EC Assets' legal counsel before publication.
EC Assets processes personal data only to provide the products you order, to meet legal obligations and to run this website. This page explains what that means in practice.
EC Assets, GmbH, Musterstraße 1, 10178, Berlin, is the controller for the processing described here. You can reach our data protection contact at privacy@ecassets.com.
Account and contact data to create and manage your customer account.
Identity and residence data to open a Blocked Account and arrange insurance, as required by banking and immigration rules.
Payment data to process deposits and fees through our banking and payments partners.
Usage data from this website to keep it secure and to understand how it is used, based on your consent where the law requires it.
Our partner bank, our insurance partners and our payments provider receive the data they need to deliver the product you ordered. We do not sell personal data.
Where a partner or service provider is based outside the European Economic Area, we rely on adequacy decisions or standard contractual clauses.
We keep data for as long as your contract runs and for the retention periods that commercial and tax law require, typically six to ten years.
You can request access to your data, correction, deletion, restriction of processing and a copy in a portable format. You can withdraw consent at any time and complain to a supervisory authority.
We use strictly necessary cookies to run the site. Analytics and marketing cookies are set only with your consent, which you can change in the cookie settings.
We update this policy when our products or the law change. The date of the latest version is shown here: 18 September 2026.
